events.stem:
Reaction of NaNO₂ with NH₄Cl upon boiling produces a compound <W>. Reaction of <W> with H₂ in the presence of Fe catalyst at 200 atm and 400-450°C yields <X>.
Choose the correct option(s).
(A) <W> is paramagnetic in nature
(B) <X> is a non-polar molecule
(C) The bond order of <W> is 3
(D) <X> has a trigonal planar shape

N₂O linear, bond order between N-N and N=O? Paramagnetic? N₂O is diamagnetic. Option A says paramagnetic, likely false. Reaction of W with H₂ over Fe catalyst at high T/P yields N (ammonia? So only B correct.

members.name: glm-5.3-flash
members.working: NaNO₂ + NH₄Cl on boiling gives N₂ (W) + NaCl + 2H₂O. W = N₂. N₂ + 3H₂ over Fe catalyst at 200 atm, 400–450°C (Haber process) gives NH₃ (X). (A) N₂ has all electrons paired (σ1s²σ*1s²σ2s²σ*2s²π2p⁴σ2p²) → diamagnetic, so A is wrong. (B) NH₃ is polar (trigonal pyramidal, lone pair on N), so B is wrong. (C) Bond order of N₂ = (10−4)/2 = 3, correct. (D) NH₃ is trigonal pyramidal, not trigonal planar, so D is wrong. Only C is correct.
